name: Operational Structure Encoding
description: Replaces mathematical graph-theoretic guarantees (e.g., induced edge counts, explicit m=n-1) with an operational process description (e.g., each of the m agreements strictly reduces the number of independent entities by one, ultimately forming a single entity). This forces the model to logically deduce the tree structure (since n entities reduced to 1 in m steps implies m = n-1 and no cycles) rather than relying on surface-level keyword triggers, causing pattern-matching models to fall back to intractable general algorithms.
